import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))
report = {"repo": str(repo), "python": sys.version.split()[0], "checks": []}

def command(name, argv, timeout):
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=repo, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        item = {"name": name, "passed": result.returncode == 0, "returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout[-6000:], "stderr": result.stderr[-6000:]}
    except Exception as exc:
        item = {"name": name, "passed": False, "error": str(exc)}
    report["checks"].append(item)
    print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)

command("repository_state", ["git", "status", "--short"], 15)
command("repository_head", ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], 15)
command("unit_regression_suite", [sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-v"], 180)
npm = shutil.which("npm")
if npm:
    command("npm_launcher_suite", [npm, "test"], 60)
else:
    report["checks"].append({"name": "npm_launcher_suite", "passed": False, "error": "npm unavailable in service environment"})
command("disposable_real_chrome_smoke", [sys.executable, "tools/browser_smoke.py", "--background"], 120)
command("project_service_status", [sys.executable, "-m", "do_again.cli", "status"], 30)
try:
    from do_again.browser.runtime import browser_status, browser_self_test
    before = browser_status()
    result = browser_self_test()
    after = browser_status()
    response = result.get("response", "")
    item = {"name": "authenticated_chatgpt_round_trip", "passed": response.strip() == "DO_AGAIN_BROWSER_OK", "response": response[:500], "chat_url": result.get("chat_url"), "mode_before": before.get("mode"), "mode_after": after.get("mode"), "pid_before": before.get("pid"), "pid_after": after.get("pid")}
except Exception as exc:
    item = {"name": "authenticated_chatgpt_round_trip", "passed": False, "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
report["checks"].append(item)
print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
report["passed"] = all(item["passed"] for item in report["checks"])
print("DO_AGAIN_LIVE_TEST_REPORT=" + json.dumps(report), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)
